goal: Process the entire capture at a frozen 5 Hz temporal sampling, then run one fresh 30000-update DN-Splatter baseline, all available heldout evaluations, a full-timeline rendering and the historical raw Poisson export without intermediate review gates.

review.scope: Committed source, completed capture-s01 results, numeric reports and representative previews were reviewed; the full capture and AutoDL server were not accessed in this planning task.

paths.relative_paths_base: The existing DN-Splatter project checkout on the executing host; server paths are relative to server_project_root.

capture.final_human_occlusion_and_camera_roll: Retain in the requested timeline and report their effects; do not truncate or silently discard them.

selection.synchronization_timebase: recorded device timestamps, not bag wall-clock write time
selection.first_241_source_identities: Must match the committed capture-s01 selection by original RGB index and device timestamp; reuse these identities, not just similarly named files.
objective_unavailability_reasons: no unique RGB-D association within the fixed tolerance
required source bytes or calibration cannot be read
selection.blur_and_dynamic_content: Annotate for result interpretation; keep usable frames in their frozen roles.

split.rule: Frozen original candidate_index modulo 10: residues 0-7 train, 8 val, 9 test.
split.coverage_denominator: Keep requested, selected, pose-available, trained and evaluated counts distinct; unavailable candidates remain in coverage reports.

pose.strategy: One global primary-training SfM map, followed by heldout localization against its frozen geometry.
pose.default_matching: Existing CUDA SIFT plus exhaustive matching on the frozen primary-training images.
pose.optional_sequential_prefill: Sequential matching may run first in the same database, then exhaustive matching reuses existing pairs.
pose.existing_native_global_retrieval_alterna: If already installed and operational, native COLMAP global retrieval may be selected once instead of exhaustive matching; record the exact route, options and vocabulary/index provenance.
pose.select_connected_component: Choose the usable connected model with the most registered primary-training frames; report all components and temporal coverage rather than combining independently scaled models.

bridge_fallback.trigger: An actual tracking or mapping discontinuity in the initial global solve.
bridge_fallback.source_identity_exclusion: Exclude every frozen full-capture val/test RGB source identity and the union of all old s01 val/test identities, including unavailable primary candidates.

heldout_localization.initial_route: Reuse the existing four-nearest-primary-training-view feature/PnP route.
heldout_localization.bounded_retry: For actual localization failures, expand matching once to broader or global registered training candidates; retain fixed map geometry.
heldout_localization.failures: Keep source identities and reasons in the original denominators; continue all available heldout frames.

pose.partial_pose_failure: After the bounded repair, continue the complete pipeline on a usable connected primary-training model and set completed_with_coverage_gaps when requested coverage is missing.

geometry.depth_format: float32 NPY color-camera optical-axis Z in metres
geometry.pixel_center_convention: Reuse the s01 conversion, including its pixel-center adjustment exactly once.
geometry.scale_fit_source: Only depth-supported observations from registered frozen primary-training frames; explicitly exclude auxiliary and heldout observations.
geometry.init_source: Registered primary-training RGB-D only; no auxiliary, val or test contribution.
geometry.init_filtering: Reuse existing s01 D2C competition and near-side depth-discontinuity exclusion.
geometry.scene_scale_rule: max(15, ceil(1.1 * max(abs(registered_primary_train_camera_centers), abs(init_points)))) in the final metric frame
geometry.training_input_copy_strategy: reflink or ordinary copy; no writable hardlinks to geometry originals

parser.name: normal-nerfstudio
parser.scene_scale_source: geometry.scene_scale_rule; resolve once from the available training data and record the actual value.

normal_prior.data_scope: All selected primary frames retained in the geometry dataset; split-selective loading remains enforced.
normal_prior.expected_count_rule: Match the actual exported primary-frame identities, not the old constant 241.

diagnostics.cross_view_reference: Same-capture sensor consistency, not independent geometric ground truth.

training.other_algorithm_fields: Reuse s01 historical optimizer, learning-rate, densification and model defaults; do not multiply updates or alter the densification schedule because there are more images.
training.first_batch_check: Record finiteness of the actual first formal training batch and its losses within the 30000-update run; do not launch a separate smoke training job.

conditional_adaptations.principle: Apply only when a concrete full-capture input or execution condition requires it; retain the old non-triggering behavior and record patches and counts.

empty_sensor_reference_or_directional_re.trigger: An actual frame has no valid sensor Z in [0.3,6], or an EdgeAwareLogL1 directional cropped mask is empty even when the full image mask is nonempty.
empty_sensor_reference_or_directional_re.dataset_export: If zero-valid-depth frames occur, remove only the positive-coverage assertion and retain their all-zero depth arrays and frozen roles.
empty_sensor_reference_or_directional_re.loss_behavior: For each empty directional reduction return a differentiable zero, such as that empty selected loss tensor's sum; preserve the historical mean for every nonempty direction. A wholly empty sensor mask contributes zero sensor loss while other losses remain active.
empty_sensor_reference_or_directional_re.internal_depth_metrics: When no reference support exists, omit or mark unsupported depth scalars instead of emitting NaN; do not fabricate zero error.
empty_sensor_reference_or_directional_re.evaluation_behavior: Depth metrics are null for frames with zero valid reference pixels, with explicit valid-depth-frame and valid-pixel counts; their RGB metrics remain included.

memory_capacity.trigger: One concrete preload estimate or actual allocation failure shows the full data cache exceeds currently available capacity.
memory_capacity.permitted: Numerically equivalent bounded caching or streaming of the same full-resolution frozen dataset; record actual cache policy.

real_execution_failures.policy: Keep error evidence, make a bounded necessary compatibility or numerical correction, and resume the same run identity. Do not start parameter sweeps or unrelated cleanup.

evaluation.scope: Every selected, localized frame in each frozen heldout split; separately publish unavailable frame identities and coverage against the full requested split.
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step; no test-based model selection
evaluation.reference_depth_mask: finite original sensor Z in [0.3,6] and >0; no prediction-dependent or error-dependent exclusion
evaluation.invalid_predictions: Report counts and support; do not silently remove invalid predictions from the primary reference denominator.
evaluation.temporal_axis: relative to the first depth device timestamp, as in the audit

optional_prior_s01_comparison.identity: Exact original RGB indices and device timestamps from the frozen s01 heldout list.

accumulation_zero_diagnostic.reason: Historical rendered depth may be finite after filling alpha==0 pixels, so positive finite Z alone does not establish surface support.

evaluation.depth_interpretation: same-capture sensor consistency; no independent geometric ground truth
evaluation.raw_renders: All available val/test frames retained on AutoDL, plus representative fixed-time and worst-case previews in the report.

video.trajectory: Entire frozen 5 Hz primary timeline, including appended endpoint when present.
video.unavailable_pose_frames: Render explicit gap cards or visibly marked missing intervals at the original timeline positions; do not concatenate away missing time.

mesh.expected_views_rule: Actual registered primary-training count, not the old constant 193.
mesh.n_threads: Actual allocated CPU budget without nested oversubscription.
mesh.invalid_normal_policy: Report nonfinite or zero sampled normals; only if export actually fails, preserve failure evidence and make the minimum numerical correction with counts and a recorded patch.

terminal_statuses.completed: Full requested coverage processed, formal training has exactly 30000 updates, all heldout evaluation/rendering and raw mesh deliverables completed.
terminal_statuses.completed_with_coverage_gaps: The complete available-data pipeline finished but requested selection, pose or evaluation coverage is incomplete; publish the full denominators and all gap identities.
terminal_statuses.blocked: A concrete data, connectivity, environment or execution error prevents the remaining required work; publish the error and completed artifacts. Lack of a usable primary-training map is a blocker.

resource_policy.github_preferred_transport: AutoDL official /etc/network_turbo in a project subshell, using official GitHub HTTPS URLs.
